mechanisms.title: SkyDiscover Optimize and Synthesize capability boundary, 2026 main
mechanisms.summary: The current framework separates evaluator-driven Optimize from skill-based system Synthesize. Optimize supports adaptive program search, container evaluators, evaluator artifacts, and AdaEvolve Pareto objectives; Synthesize is described as Codex/Claude-compatible tooling but is not the same as the Optimize CLI search surface.
mechanisms.name: Executable multi-objective algorithm search
mechanisms.description: AdaEvolve adapts exploration across populations and can optimize explicit Pareto objectives while evaluator artifacts feed failure mechanisms into later candidate prompts.
mechanisms.limitations: Search cannot create missing observation information and will exploit evaluator shortcuts if truth, denominators, hard invalidity, or hidden boundaries are weak.

uses.project_application: Use a new evaluator whose only target observations are BlindAssist support-ray and temporal-belief SEARCH, SET_VALUED, COMMIT, and REACQUIRE states from real ordered portal views.
uses.expected_effect: Discover active disambiguation policies that improve task completion without buying precision through abstention or relying on OCR-only identity.
uses.observed_effect: The first real prefix retained correct portal-set truth in 0/2 frames. The raw belief falsely changed SET_VALUED to COMMIT on a large foreground/escalator proposal; requiring center-and-approach scale consistency changed it to SET_VALUED to SET_VALUED and removed that observed false commit. Correct localization was not recovered, so SkyDiscover search is not authorized yet.
uses.claim_boundary: This is an integration decision, not evidence that SkyDiscover improves real BlindAssist perception, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Current Optimize/Synthesize positioning, evaluators, artifacts, Pareto support, and search methods.
New perception-policy contract with hard false-commit and arrival gates plus explicit AdaEvolve Pareto objectives.
First real non-OCR ordered-view prefix: 0/2 portal-set truth retention before the scale-consistency belief replay.
Frozen portal-set truth and the reverse-side proxy claim boundary.

Optimize supports adaptive program search, container evaluators, evaluator artifacts, and AdaEvolve Pareto objectives; Synthesize is described as Codex/Claude-compatible tooling but is not the same as the Optimize CLI search surface.
mechanisms.name: Optimize versus Synthesize boundary
mechanisms.description: Optimize evolves a bounded program against an evaluator. The README presents Synthesize as separate test-driven or inductive-deductive skill tooling for multi-file systems; Optimize agentic mode currently exposes read_file and search rather than arbitrary repository mutation.
outputs: Bounded optimized program or separately synthesized system
mechanisms.limitations: Do not claim that the Optimize CLI is a general Codex-style multi-file implementation agent.

uses.project_application: Use a new evaluator whose only target observations are BlindAssist support-ray and temporal-belief SEARCH, SET_VALUED, COMMIT, and REACQUIRE states from real ordered portal views.
uses.expected_effect: Discover active disambiguation policies that improve task completion without buying precision through abstention or relying on OCR-only identity.
uses.observed_effect: The first real prefix retained correct portal-set truth in 0/2 frames. The raw belief falsely changed SET_VALUED to COMMIT on a large foreground/escalator proposal; requiring center-and-approach scale consistency changed it to SET_VALUED to SET_VALUED and removed that observed false commit. Correct localization was not recovered, so SkyDiscover search is not authorized yet.
uses.claim_boundary: This is an integration decision, not evidence that SkyDiscover improves real BlindAssist perception, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Current Optimize/Synthesize positioning, evaluators, artifacts, Pareto support, and search methods.
New perception-policy contract with hard false-commit and arrival gates plus explicit AdaEvolve Pareto objectives.
First real non-OCR ordered-view prefix: 0/2 portal-set truth retention before the scale-consistency belief replay.
Frozen portal-set truth and the reverse-side proxy claim boundary.
